steps.title: Click Pre-advise Export
steps.instruction: Export container that is expected to enter the terminal for loading onto a vessel.

steps.title: Click Equipment Number:
steps.instruction: Equipment Number is the unique identification number assigned to a physical container.

steps.title: Click Equipment Type:
steps.instruction: Identifies the type/size of the container

steps.title: Click Gross Weight (kg):
steps.instruction: Gross Weight is the total weight of the container including the cargo and the container itself.

annotations.text: Type the Gross Weight Between 15000 to 30000
annotations.htmlContent: Type the Gross Weight Between 15000 to 30000

steps.title: Click Carrie Mode
steps.instruction: Carrier Mode identifies how the container is transported to or from the terminal

steps.title: Click Line Operator:
steps.instruction: Line Operator is the shipping company responsible for the container and its transportation/shipment.

steps.title: Click Booking Number:
steps.instruction: Booking Number is a unique reference number used to identify a customer's booking for vessel visit

annotations.text: Type the Booking Number AXZQ or 111JKY
annotations.htmlContent: Type the Booking Number AXZQ or 111JKY
